newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end slightly firmer, EuroSwiss gain.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end slightly firmer, EuroSwiss gain.

text.p: 1515 GMT - Swiss bonds were slightly firmer at the close of trade, with the short end reversing an early negative tone while the long end rose marginally. Swiss CPI due Tuesday. * Sept Conf futures up four basis points at 120.30 * 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yields 3.415 pct vs 3.43 pct
